name_reason: Compliant with data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: domain=ui_menu (chapter-intro menu/shop/roster/promote UI), descriptor=scroll_offset accurately names its role as the scroll viewport top-row index. No Ghidra address residue (no hex suffix tied to 0x5412f or any data address). Consistent with sibling menu-state globals data_fd2_ui_menu_cursor_idx / data_fd2_ui_menu_saved_scroll_offset / data_fd2_ui_menu_visible_item_count.
purpose: Shared menu-scroll state: top-row index of the 6-item visible viewport in every chapter-intro roster/shop/promote grid.
logic_summary: Top index of the 6-item viewport. Paged in steps of 2 for the 2-wide buy/sell/give/roster grids and steps of 1 for the 1-wide promote lists. Every menu loop writes 0 to it during setup before the first read (fd2_shop_menu_input_loop, fd2_party_roster_single_select_loop, fd2_party_roster_class_select_loop, fd2_promote_member(s)_select_loop, chapter-intro dialog loops); fd2_run_buy_item_menu reloads it from data_fd2_ui_menu_saved_scroll_offset and writes it back to persist across panel re-opens. Grid renderers (fd2_render_chapter_intro_dialog_panels, fd2_render_party_roster_grid, fd2_render_shop_item_grid, fd2_render_promote_members_grid, fd2_render_promote_candidates_grid, fd2_render_party_roster_with_item_stat_preview) read it as scroll_offset+iter to index the list and compare against the cursor for the selection border. Comparisons against the cursor index are signed (readers cast to int32 at the use site: MOV/SUB DWORD + JL/JGE).
element_semantics: Single 32-bit scalar holding the viewport top-row index (a small non-negative menu/grid scroll position). Declared uint32 to match the sibling menu-state globals.
notes: Memory at 0x5412f is statically zero (read_memory: all zeros) confirming BSS, not const. xrefs_to show WRITE sites (fd2_run_buy_item_menu, fd2_shop_menu_input_loop, fd2_party_roster_single/class_select_loop, fd2_run_sell/give_item_menu, fd2_promote_member(s)_select_loop) and READ sites (the fd2_render_* grid renderers) -> mutable BSS scalar, is_const=false. Verified access semantics by decompiling fd2_party_roster_single_select_loop (writes 0 in setup, pages +-2) and fd2_render_promote_candidates_grid (reads scroll_offset+iter). src comment block (shop.c lines ~822-842) already precise/ASCII/accurate -> comment kept, shop.c not edited. Ghidra data plate was null/empty -> created a concise PLATE_COMMENT via run_script_inline and saved_program (success).
